description: How to lay out and read a year-ahead tarot spread: one theme card and twelve monthly cards, with tips for reading patterns and using it as a reflection tool.
lede: The year-ahead tarot spread uses a theme card plus one card for each month. It works best as a prompt for planning and reflection, not as a forecast.

layout.alt: Thirteen gold-edged tarot cards under the heading A year-ahead tarot spread. One card numbered 1 and labelled Theme sits at the top centre. Below it are two rows of six cards: January to June on the upper row and July to December on the lower row, each labelled Jan to Dec.
layout.caption: One theme card sits above twelve monthly cards, January to June on the upper row and July to December below. Read the theme first, then the months in order.
